durationScope: Single adapter wall time including startup and SVG validation; excludes generation, PNG capture and review. Not a comparative performance benchmark.
renderer: D2 native WASM Node API (default layout)

svg.note: Structural SVG measurements only; not node/edge counts, text visibility, overlap detection, or visual-quality scores.

logNote: Successful SVG payload is output.svg rather than duplicated in stdout.log; browser diagnostics and subprocess error streams are retained. D2 API errors are recorded in error.
